records.name: White Rocks
records.description_rewritten: White Rocks is a large former military and holiday complex near Pembroke/Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq. Older directory comments describe exploring abandoned buildings, including one warning that night visits are unsafe. In 2026 the government cleared debris, fenced dangerous areas and reopened safe portions while planning a national park. Historic descriptions of abandoned corridors may now be obsolete.
records.place_identity: White Rocks complex, between Pembroke and Baħar iċ-Ċagħaq, entered in directory under Naxxar; current controlled public areas only.
records.access_conditions: May 2026 government re-opened designated safe parts. Avoid fenced/dangerous buildings; follow current Project Green signage and access routes.
